dataflow.summary: Authenticated Users file write -> elevated PowerShell file load -> attacker statements -> administrator actions

impact.why: Substituted PowerShell can perform arbitrary administrator actions.

likelihood.why: Local access plus operator elevated invocation are required; the candidate remains unexecuted and blocked.

reachability.attacker: Local authenticated user distinct from trusted owner/admin
reachability.summary: Exact saved file ACL permits the write; a human elevated invocation remains necessary. No public ingress or installed service is introduced.

attackPath.summary: A local authenticated writer modifies the harness before the administrator launches it. Elevated PowerShell executes the replacement code, which can omit the self-hash block.

codeEvidence.explanation: The editable script itself chooses whether to compare its on-disk bytes; an Authenticated Users writer can remove this block or prepend statements, which PowerShell evaluates before the supposed integrity gate.
codeEvidence.label: Self-hash runs inside the loaded script

codeEvidence.explanation: The intended invocation already has an administrator token. Attacker-provided script statements inherit that authority; this check cannot authenticate who wrote them.
codeEvidence.label: Entrypoint expects administrator authority

confidence.rationale: Immutable source confirms evaluation-before-self-check; saved ACL evidence for the exact script confirms the distinct lower-trust writer. No dynamic exploit was performed.

preventiveControls: Keep all privilege-granting bootstrap bytes and fixed digests outside lower-trust writable custody.

provenance.reviewer: Independent static diff reviewer; supplied ACL evidence from engineering coordinator

findings.remediation: Use a separately trusted bootstrap to read script bytes, compare them to an immutable approved digest before any evaluation, then execute those exact verified bytes without reopening a mutable path. Bind adjacent pins in the trusted bootstrap or the verified payload. Protect the executable/evidence ancestor custody, use a trusted absolute interpreter with profiles disabled, and do not rely on self-hashing or current-directory ownership.
remediationTests: In an isolated authorized test, change the mutable input before verification and ensure no payload statement executes.
Change the source path after verification and prove only the verified in-memory bytes execute.
Reject untrusted parent/reparse replacement and altered pins; retain refusal evidence.

rootCause.summary: The integrity boundary is placed inside the object it is meant to authenticate. The operator passes a mutable path to elevated PowerShell; PowerShell loads and starts the script before line14 compares its path hash to the approval record. The exact script is writable by Authenticated Users, so a distinct lower-trust writer can change the code that performs the check. Adjacent pins and later protected binary staging do not establish trusted custody of the script bytes before evaluation.

severity.changeConditions: A trusted bootstrap verifying exact bytes before evaluation and executing the same bytes with trusted interpreter configuration and fixed pins would remove this path. An unattended privileged launcher would increase likelihood.
severity.rationale: Arbitrary administrator code execution has high impact. Exploitation requires local write access and an administrator launching this unexecuted candidate, so likelihood is medium. No actual elevated run or compromise occurred.

findings.summary: An authenticated local user can replace the prepared Run-I2Feasibility.ps1, whose saved exact-path DACL grants Authenticated Users Modify. If the operator then invokes that file in elevated PowerShell, substituted statements execute before or instead of its self-hash check. The later protected EtwCapture.exe copy cannot authenticate the already executing harness.

taxonomy.category: Privileged code loading from a less-trusted writable file

findings.title: Launching the writable harness elevated allows local users to execute administrator commands

assertions: The script self-check occurs after PowerShell begins evaluating the supplied file.
The saved ACL evidence applies to the precise executable script path, not merely its working directory.
Protected binary copy cannot retroactively protect the script entrypoint.
limitations: No live write, elevation or exploit performed.
ACL evidence was read from a supplied saved record, not independently queried.
Requires the human operator to launch the prepared path elevated.
validation.method: Static immutable-source trace and supplied exact-path ACL record
validation.summary: The saved script DACL contains (A;ID;0x1301bf;;;AU), allowing authenticated writers. The source puts its own digest check inside the intended elevated script. No external protected loader is included in this diff.
